name: Nico Robin
effect: [On Play] Up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 8 or less cannot be rested until the end of your opponent's next End Phase.

official_faq.question: Do effects that read "cannot be rested" mean that the affected Characters cannot attack?
official_faq.answer: Yes, the affected Characters cannot attack. These effects make the affected Characters unable to perform any actions that require them to be rested, such as attacking or activating [Blocker].

official_faq.question: Do effects that read "cannot be rested" mean that the affected Characters cannot activate effects such as "[Activate: Main] You may rest this Character:" and other similar effects?
official_faq.answer: Yes, the affected Characters cannot activate those effects. These effects make the affected Characters unable to perform any actions that require them to be rested, such as attacking or activating [Blocker].

official_faq.question: Do effects that read "cannot be rested" mean that the affected Characters cannot activate [Blocker]?
official_faq.answer: Yes, the affected Characters cannot activate [Blocker]. These effects make the affected Characters unable to perform any actions that require them to be rested, such as attacking or activating [Blocker].

official_faq.question: Do effects that read "cannot be rested" mean that the affected Characters cannot become rested by the effects of your or your opponent's other cards?
official_faq.answer: Yes, the affected Characters cannot be rested by the effects of other cards. These effects make the affected Characters unable to perform any actions that require them to be rested, such as attacking or activating [Blocker].
